name: International Health (Global Health Sciences), Ph.D.
department: Graduate School of Medicine — School of International Health

deadline.value: January 7, 2027 (application window Jan 5-7, 2027 for April 2027 entry; TOEFL/IELTS exemption requests for April 2027 entry closed Nov 9, 2026; October 2026 entry closed June 17, 2026).
deadline.quote: application for April 2027 entry between Tuesday, 5 January and Thursday, 7 January, 2027

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for this field (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

english_waiver.value: TOEFL/IELTS waiver is available if the applicant's entire bachelor's institution (not just the department) had English as the primary language of instruction and an institutional certificate is submitted for advance review (Nov 9, 2026 for April 2027 entry; master's MOI does not qualify).
english_waiver.quote: where English is the primary language of instruction for the entire institution, not just the applicant's specific department or program. In this case, the applicant must provide a certificate issued by the institution, confirming the primary language of instruction.

supervisor.value: Applicants to the School of International Health Doctoral Program must contact a faculty member before applying.
supervisor.quote: Applicants must contact faculty member before applying.

funding.value: Competitive funding via MEXT Scholarships, the University of Tokyo Fellowship, MEXT Honors Scholarship, JSPS DC fellowships, and private foundation scholarships.
funding.quote: A variety of scholarships are available for students who wish to study in Japan. Although many of them are provided by external entities, there are some scholarships awarded directly by the University of Tokyo.

entry_route.value: Requires a Master's or professional degree from a Japanese or foreign university (or 2+ years of post-bachelor's research via individual eligibility review).
entry_route.quote: Persons who have been awarded or are expected to be awarded by 31 March 2027 (Note 5) an academic degree in a foreign country which is equivalent to a master's or professional degree

notes: School of International Health admits for both October and April entries using English TOEFL/IELTS screening + online oral exam (no Japanese proficiency certificate required, unlike the 4-year Doctoral Program in Medicine). Also covers Human Genetics and Biomedical Chemistry majors.
